## Summary

Describe the protocol, schema, example, or documentation change.

## Review Focus

- [ ] Authority boundaries

- [ ] Human Decision Gate semantics

## Checks

- [ ] Links resolve from the repository root.
- [ ] Draft status is preserved; this does not claim HACP is a standard.

      authority is added to the base vocabulary.
